identity.title: [C-SDLC v2][defect] Permit implemented-phase VPP/SOR/SPP truth repair for WP-18C parent closeout

values.summary: Bootstrap and bind #388, add the narrow implemented-phase card-truth repair operations and refusal tests, validate, obtain fresh exact-head review, publish, CI, and finish so #114 can consume the new typed route.

steps.action: Bootstrap, review, approve, doctor, and bind #388.
Implement bounded SPP/VPP/SOR card-truth repair operations and audit records, including SOR empty-vector removal and blank-entry refusal.
Run focused tests, strict hygiene, fresh review, publish, CI, and finish.

invariants: Active review/publication/readiness/terminal truth invalidates card repair authority
Repairs are exact-card and exact-field only
Issue topology and product source are unchanged by card repair operations
risks: Too broad a repair operation could become generic implemented-phase card rewriting
Recovery epoch detection could accidentally span unrelated review cycles
Existing #363 tests could regress if SPP summary guard is widened incorrectly
stop_conditions: Need to authorize generic implemented-phase set_field
Required validation or hosted CI fails
